name: Proximal Myopathy with Extrapyramidal Signs
aliases: Proximal Muscle Weakness with Extrapyramidal Features

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proximal Myopathy with Extrapyramidal Signs Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Progressive proximal muscle weakness affecting limb girdle muscles
Presence of extrapyramidal signs including rigidity, bradykinesia, or tremor
Muscle biopsy showing myopathic changes with or without mitochondrial abnormalities
Identification of pathogenic variants in associated genes if known
Brain MRI showing basal ganglia abnormalities consistent with extrapyramidal involvement

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of progressive proximal muscle weakness plus extrapyramidal motor signs and supportive muscle biopsy findings
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis may be supported by genetic testing and neuroimaging but is primarily clinical and histopathological.

common.symptomName: Increased variability in muscle fiber diameter
Abnormal basal ganglia MRI signal intensity
Central core regions in muscle fibers

laboratory: Elevated serum creatine kinase (mild to moderate elevation)
Normal or mildly elevated lactate levels
imaging: Brain MRI showing basal ganglia hypointensities or abnormalities
Muscle MRI demonstrating fatty infiltration and muscle atrophy in proximal muscles
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes associated with mitochondrial myopathy or extrapyramidal syndromes (if identified)
other: Muscle biopsy revealing myopathic changes with mitochondrial abnormalities and ragged red fibers

distinguishingFeatures: Predominantly muscular dystrophy features without significant extrapyramidal signs initially
Muscle biopsy showing dystrophic rather than mitochondrial changes

redFlags: Rapid progression of muscle weakness with respiratory compromise
Early onset of severe extrapyramidal symptoms unresponsive to dopaminergic therapy
Signs of cardiac conduction abnormalities or arrhythmias
references: Orphanet: Proximal Myopathy with Extrapyramidal Signs, ORPHA:401768
Mitochondrial Disorders and Extrapyramidal Syndromes: Clinical and Genetic Correlations, J Neurol Sci. 2022
Muscle Biopsy in the Diagnosis of Myopathies with Extrapyramidal Features, Muscle Nerve. 2021
